name: Survey tile in Aries
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.3 degrees south of the ecliptic in Aries, imaged by SPHEREx 20 times in 6 visits over 60 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 40 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.5 days starting 2026-01-30, at wavelengths from 0.96 to 4.73 µm. The pipeline found 2 moving objects.
